## Overview

This document is automatically generated from `pilot_log.xlsx`. 
Do not edit this file directly — edit the Excel file and re-knit.

```{r counts}
papers    <- read_excel("pilot_log.xlsx", sheet = "papers")
issues    <- read_excel("pilot_log.xlsx", sheet = "issues")
ontology  <- read_excel("pilot_log.xlsx", sheet = "ontology")
gene_map  <- read_excel("pilot_log.xlsx", sheet = "gene_mapping")
amendments <- read_excel("pilot_log.xlsx", sheet = "amendments")
```

**Papers extracted:** `r nrow(papers)`  
**Issues logged:** `r nrow(issues)`  
**Ontology decisions:** `r nrow(ontology)`  
**Protocol amendments required:** `r nrow(amendments)`  

---

## 1. Pilot papers

```{r papers}
kable(papers, 
      col.names = c("ID", "First author", "Year", "Phenotype", 
                    "Platform", "Breed", "Open data", "Era", "Notes"))
```

---

## 2. Issues log

### 2.1 Ambiguous fields

```{r ambiguous}
amb <- issues[issues$category == "ambiguous_field", 
              c("paper_id", "field", "description", 
                "proposed_resolution", "priority")]
if (nrow(amb) > 0) {
  kable(amb, col.names = c("Paper", "Field", "Issue", 
                            "Proposed resolution", "Priority"))
} else {
  cat("*None logged yet.*")
}
```

### 2.2 Missing fields

```{r missing}
mis <- issues[issues$category == "missing_field",
              c("paper_id", "field", "description", 
                "proposed_resolution", "priority")]
if (nrow(mis) > 0) {
  kable(mis, col.names = c("Paper", "Field", "Issue",
                            "Proposed new field", "Priority"))
} else {
  cat("*None logged yet.*")
}
```

### 2.3 Redundant fields

```{r redundant}
red <- issues[issues$category == "redundant_field",

  kable(red, col.names = c("Paper", "Field", "Issue",
                            "Proposed resolution", "Priority"))

```

### 2.4 Edge cases

## 5. Protocol amendments required

```{r amendments}
if (nrow(amendments) > 0) {
  kable(amendments[order(amendments$priority), ],
        col.names = c("ID", "Section", "Original text",
                      "Proposed change", "Reason", "Priority"))

}
```
